title: Annotate a visual review
statement: As a developer reviewing a change, I can annotate a specific part of a slide or diagram so my visual feedback is unambiguous.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A reviewer can draw freehand marks over a slide or diagram.
A reviewer can place and resize basic shapes over a slide or diagram.
Each mark remains associated with the slide or diagram it annotates.
Other review participants can see the annotation and its author.
An annotation does not alter the underlying source visual.
